meaning: Editorial representative identities, chosen for distinctive appearance and local association. Not a scientific ranking of recognisability, a range map or a sighting guarantee. Generated illustrations, not documentary identification plates.

new-zealand/country.name: Kea
new-zealand/country.rationale: Existing New Zealand brand bird, not a countrywide distribution claim.

colombia/pacific.name: Chocó Toucan
colombia/pacific.rationale: Distinctive Chocó forest toucan already sourced in the regional collection.

colombia/western-andes.name: Multicolored Tanager
colombia/western-andes.rationale: Colourful Colombian endemic associated with western Andean forest.

colombia/central-andes.name: Yellow-eared Parrot
colombia/central-andes.rationale: Distinctive wax-palm conservation bird of the Central Andes.

colombia/eastern-andes.name: Green-bearded Helmetcrest
colombia/eastern-andes.rationale: Distinctive high-paramo endemic already sourced for the Eastern Cordillera.

colombia/cauca-valley.name: Apical Flycatcher
colombia/cauca-valley.rationale: Characteristic dry-valley endemic with local nesting research.

colombia/magdalena-valley.name: Blue-billed Curassow
colombia/magdalena-valley.rationale: Highly distinctive conservation flagship of the middle Magdalena forest.

colombia/caribbean.name: Vermilion Cardinal
colombia/caribbean.rationale: Distinctive red-crested bird of Guajira thorn scrub, not all Caribbean habitats.

colombia/sierra-nevada-de-santa-marta.name: Santa Marta Parakeet
colombia/sierra-nevada-de-santa-marta.rationale: Namesake endemic tied to the Santa Marta massif.

colombia/llanos.name: Scarlet Ibis
colombia/llanos.rationale: Unmistakable colour and wetland association, documented in Casanare.

colombia/amazonia.name: Hoatzin
colombia/amazonia.rationale: Distinctive river-margin bird documented in Colombian Amazon research.

colombia/colombian-massif.name: Andean Condor
colombia/colombian-massif.rationale: Locally recognised Purace emblem and high-Andean conservation bird.

new-zealand/north-island.name: North Island Kōkako
new-zealand/north-island.rationale: Distinctive endemic wattlebird tied to North Island forest.

new-zealand/rakiura.name: Rakiura Tokoeka
new-zealand/rakiura.rationale: The Rakiura form of southern brown kiwi, illustrated as flightless.

new-zealand/coast.name: Hoiho / Yellow-eyed Penguin
new-zealand/coast.rationale: Distinctive Otago/Catlins coastal conservation bird; no viewing guarantee.

new-zealand/forest-and-lakes.name: Kākā
new-zealand/forest-and-lakes.rationale: Locally documented forest parrot at Nelson Lakes.

new-zealand/southern-forest.name: Mohua / Yellowhead
new-zealand/southern-forest.rationale: Distinctive yellow forest bird with documented Fiordland populations.

australia/queensland.name: Southern Cassowary
australia/queensland.rationale: Unmistakable Wet Tropics rainforest bird, illustrated as flightless.

australia/new-south-wales.name: Superb Lyrebird
australia/new-south-wales.rationale: Distinctive forest bird and display tail with NSW Parks documentation.

australia/victoria.name: Helmeted Honeyeater
australia/victoria.rationale: Distinctive Victorian endemic subspecies, not distributed throughout the state.

australia/south-australia.name: Australian Magpie (white-backed)
australia/south-australia.rationale: Species associated with the piping shrike; original bird art, not official insignia.

australia/western-australia.name: Carnaby’s Black-Cockatoo
australia/western-australia.rationale: Distinctive endemic of south-western WA, not all-state occurrence.

australia/northern-territory.name: Gouldian Finch
australia/northern-territory.rationale: Distinctive colourful savanna finch supported by NT distribution evidence.

australia/australian-capital-territory.name: Gang-gang Cockatoo
australia/australian-capital-territory.rationale: Locally recognised ACT faunal emblem; original bird art rather than insignia.

australia/jervis-bay-territory.name: Eastern Bristlebird
australia/jervis-bay-territory.rationale: Conservation flagship with a protected population at Booderee.

new-zealand/south-island.name: Kea
new-zealand/south-island.rationale: Distinctive South Island alpine parrot; not a lowland/coastal presence claim.

new-zealand/mountains.name: Kea
new-zealand/mountains.rationale: Distinctive South Island alpine parrot; not a lowland/coastal presence claim.
